entities.summary: Orthodox Church, a political institution in Cyprus during Venetian and Ottoman Cyprus (1571–1821). Grew from Ottoman forces besiege and capture Nicosia in a single assault and Fall of Famagusta after 11-month siege; Bragadin flayed alive. Led to the emergence of Ottoman Administration.
